text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Bright having dazzled so
brilliantly
during these three years in the
Twinkle Series, the
Mejiro family's
fortunes are as glorious as they've
ever
been.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling she's on track to
become an
unrivaled runner in the
future. At least, that's how
it seems...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reality proves me wrong, however...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright was juuust short! She cut in
from the
inside but couldn't quite make
it, and placed
second!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely not lacking in skill! But
that
underdog took her by storm!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What's going on with Mejiro Bright?! She came fifth today! That's fifth.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Victory has eluded her on the grand
stage! But
maybe it was never on the
cards at all?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright wins a few races but loses
by an inch
many more times. Some
onlookers even suggest
that she's simply
lacking in innate ability...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm truly sorry, Trainer... Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Where exactly did I go wrong, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When she loses races, it's plain to see
why.
There's no doubt about it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Faster, you say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's biggest advantage is her
ability to
unleash a burst of speed
during the final stretch in
long-distance
races.
choice_data_list: 最近、より輪をかけて進んでいるから
choice_data_list_en: Because it's picked up even more momentum lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But with her competition in medium
races
powering ahead early and
mid-race, it's tough for
Bright to close
the gap in the end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it's frustrating to see. If Mejiro
Bright
were running in races she was
better suited to,
she'd be on a winning
streak right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The modern Twinkle Series just isn't the
ideal
place for her. It's such a shame.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If recent trends truly are to blame, then
I... Hmm,
yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I needn't be especially concerned. That's
what it
means, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. What a relief! I feel slightly
better now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But of course they bother me... And I do
believe
that we'll need to come up with
a plan. That
said...
choice_data_list: え、よかったって……悔しくはないのか？
え、よかったって……悔しくはないの？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, you're glad...? You're not frustrated?
Wait, you're glad...? You're not frustrated?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I won't be adapting to this trend, nor
changing
who I am. And that's because...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
These trends belong to this era alone,
and there's
no telling how things will be
ten to twenty years
from now, is there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The future I have in mind is a very
long
time from now and won't arrive until
long after
I've retired from racing.
choice_data_list_en: Ten years later... twenty years later...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In the event that an era perfectly suited
to my
running style should come to
pass...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family would be in a terrible
bind
without my running experience to
draw from,
wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What ought to change will change, and
that
which should be preserved will be.
If that course
cannot be stayed amidst
the trends...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then it will be a very long time indeed
before the
Mejiro family finds success in
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Things are fine just as they are, Trainer.
Yes...
After all, the present isn't the
be-all and end-all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiros are here, I'm here... The
times are
secondary...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I haven't lost sight of it, you know. Even
on these
days of defeat, that far-off
peak remains in sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stands motionless. This is the wider

perspective of the Mejiro family. No,
actually, it's
Mejiro Bright's own vision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. What really matters... is
that I
trust in Mejiro Bright's strength,
hone it, and pass
it on to the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all, she's no ordinary Umamusume.
The goal
she's aiming for is set far
further away than most
racers could
dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright is forging down the
marathon track
of history itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's continue our pursuit as we have
been,
Trainer, without ever losing heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We'll be all right even if we do fall short
now. The
current Mejiro generation is
working ever so hard,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I expect the winners of today will have
their share
of smiles. That's a wonderful
thing in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But there is something else that's faaar
more
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
100 years from now, however drastically
the
Twinkle Series has changed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, first place will be
home...
to us.
